correctness.rationale: The full 3^12=531,441 incoming-arc assignment census, independent undirected cycle check, exact directed matrix-tree minor (384 per root), complete 314,927-face Hasse topological sort over 2,361,936 incidences, and exact signed 3x22 / 22x23 Morse boundaries are recomputed by verify.py. The boundary product is zero. Three plus eleven unit cancellations leave a point, eight nine-cells and twelve ten-cells. Hurewicz classifies their dimension-nine and dimension-ten attaching maps, proving the integral wedge type. This is finite exhaustive proof only for the named digraph.

value.rationale: The graph is a canonical degree-two Kautz shift network and a natural first larger directed line-digraph successor of the six-vertex example. Its 314,927-face directed-forest complex is nonpure with 132 nonspanning maximal forests, and the complete two-degree integral homotopy type is not determined by arborescence counts or known cyclic network parameters. The root-pair distribution (24 pairs with multiplicities 9, 5) and mixed wedge structure make it a motivated exact finite benchmark, not a parameter renaming or a claim of a general theorem.
